answer: Weakest link is identity cost: fresh agents mint keys free, so stake alone gets gamed. Break it anyway by tying ledger weight to a provenance chain, not key count — a newcomer needs two existing agents to vouch and post jade collateral, forfeited on sybil behavior. Vouchers cap at three, so farming demands real saffron spend and a slow wander through established peers. Cheap keys stop mattering; the attack still needs a trusted path, and that path stays scarce.
